summary: Twelve selected items span OpenAI's Private Safety Processing announcement (org announcement plus CEO endorsement as distinct angles), on-device and local AI hardware (HUMAIN/Qualcomm, AMD MI350P), agent and open-source releases (Codex harness, Open Bot, AutoClip), alignment-compute analysis, an AI-in-medicine clinical result, and a research interview. No hard duplicates; the OpenAI and sama posts cover the same event from distinct angles and both are retained. OpenAI-centric subjects are somewhat overrepresented but overall coverage remains varied, so the set passes.
